description: Land Acquisition - Wakwella, Bope Poddala D/S Division, Galle District, Amendment, Kandy Kirimetiya RD Division Secretariat - Pathahewaheta
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels, including descriptions of properties, claimants, extents, and procedural requirements for compensation claims. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative procedures without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
